project: Run one prepared task inside sbx

capabilities.name: One independently accepted task
capabilities.outcome: Prepared task executes inside sbx with bounded correction, independent collection and separate acceptance; no commit or dependent task prerequisite

capabilities.name: Safe interruption stop and handoff
capabilities.outcome: Preserve work and evidence; replacement coordinator sees the next action; unknown operation liveness blocks retry

capabilities.name: Truthful gates and intervention
capabilities.outcome: Invalid authority or missing/stale evidence cannot complete a task; unrecoverable blockers reach the active coordinator chat

artifacts.name: Approved task inputs and run policy
artifacts.source_of_truth: Human-reviewed brief and verification requirements plus owner-authorized policy frozen by controller
artifacts.lifecycle: Freeze task-input identity, scope, required stages, gpt-6.1-sol low/medium/high, sbx/YOLO authority and three-correction limit. Authorized safe-boundary revisions invalidate affected evidence; preserve old frozen runs. T-002 owns safe-boundary authorized revision through IF-001: atomically update input/policy identity and state version, invalidate readiness/affected evidence, retain history/correction count; refuse unauthorized or unsafe revision.

artifacts.name: Single-task status and operations
artifacts.lifecycle: Atomic state/version and reservations; persist run/task/input/flow identity, stage, correction count, candidate, evidence locations, outstanding findings, required evidence, operation, next action and blocker. Unknown liveness stops retry; history retained; invalid requests do not change authority. Readiness references admitted terminal preflight ART-004 and current ART-001 identity.

artifacts.name: Candidate and scope evidence
artifacts.lifecycle: Identity covers relevant tracked/untracked bytes, baseline, configuration and task inputs; relevant changes supersede checks, collection and acceptance.

artifacts.name: Assignment and actor outcome
artifacts.lifecycle: Bind task/input/candidate/role/operation and adapter-observed session identity; actor prose cannot complete; retain rejected outcomes as diagnostics.

artifacts.name: Verification evidence
artifacts.lifecycle: Real command/setup/environment/outcome bound to evaluated inputs and candidate; collector reruns through controller runner; superseded evidence remains historical.

artifacts.name: Independent collection report and findings
artifacts.source_of_truth: Fresh collector evidence admitted by controller
artifacts.producer: Independent collector via adapter; T-003 captures raw transport, T-004 owns semantic admission
artifacts.lifecycle: Coverage and stable finding identities/dispositions; no final acceptance verdict. Relevant edits invalidate coverage; preserve historical evidence.

artifacts.name: Completion and intervention records
artifacts.lifecycle: Idempotent single-task completion or persisted blocker with chat relay/response history; acknowledgement is not permission. No automatic commit or dependency release. Supersedes old planned commit/finalization scope.

artifacts.name: Supported harness contract
artifacts.source_of_truth: Historical T-001 transport evidence plus T-003 successor supplement
artifacts.producer: T-001 investigator; T-003 owns updated sbx runtime supplement
artifacts.lifecycle: Preserve old qualification limits. Selected Python/Codex CLI bridge is reused; actual sbx model/YOLO launch, identity, output and terminality are proved in owning tasks. Old isolation gaps are not aggregate entry gates.

artifacts.name: Separate acceptance decision
artifacts.source_of_truth: Fresh separate acceptance reviewer decision admitted by controller
artifacts.producer: Acceptance reviewer via adapter; T-003 captures raw transport, T-005 owns semantic admission
artifacts.lifecycle: Bind current inputs/candidate/checks/collection; choose accept, correction, missing evidence or blocker with rationale/dispositions. Separate from implementation and collection; edits invalidate eligibility.

artifacts.name: Approved known-issue records when needed
artifacts.source_of_truth: Repository-declared tracker or active installed skill default
artifacts.lifecycle: Conditional on a deferral; stable IDs, decision provenance and retained history; idempotent recording before completion. Recording cannot conceal implementation drift, waive requirements or grant acceptance. JSON migration remains deferred. Declare tracker path in scope and validate recording separately; unchanged disposition-only updates do not supersede implementation evidence unless the tracker is an implementation/check input. Other evaluated-file/input changes require new evidence.

interfaces.name: Status, reserve and revise approved inputs
interfaces.contract: Expose stage/evidence/next action; reserve against expected version, authority, one active operation and persistent three-correction limit. Required preflight/collection/acceptance cannot be omitted. Invalid requests preserve state/version/files; diagnostics separate. T-002 owns authorized ART-001 revision: no reserved/running/unknown operation and task not completed; check authority/expected version, atomically bump input identity and state version, invalidate readiness/affected evidence, retain history/correction count. Refuse otherwise unchanged.

interfaces.name: Launch, observe, collect and stop inside sbx
interfaces.contract: Apply frozen approved model/context and explicit sbx/YOLO policy. Adapter observes operation/session provenance. Same operation key cannot launch twice; unknown liveness blocks retries. Preserve output and terminality evidence; no tool-exclusion guarantee or automatic recovery service required.

interfaces.name: Inspect, check and admit distinct role evidence
interfaces.contract: Inspect scope/candidate/input identity; run real configured checks and collector reruns. Admit independent collection separately from fresh acceptance; validate role/subject/provenance/current coverage. Missing, malformed or stale evidence cannot advance. T-003 owns terminal preflight admission into ART-002 readiness; T-004 owns ART-006 semantic admission; T-005 owns ART-009 semantic admission, extending the same controller path.

interfaces.name: Complete, stop and request intervention
interfaces.contract: Require terminality, approved scope, current required checks/independent collection, separate acceptance, no unresolved blocker and any approved deferral recorded. Publish single-task completion once; no commit/dependency gate. Otherwise route recovery or persist precise blocker for active-chat relay; acknowledgement grants only explicit authority. T-003 owns stop/intervene/blocker persistence only; T-005 owns completion gate/publication.

invariants.statement: Actor output cannot change authority or omit required preflight, collection or separate acceptance.
invariants.verification: Invalid requests preserve state/version/policy/files; weaker profiles cannot omit required stages.

invariants.statement: One active operation; uncertain liveness blocks retry and completion.
invariants.verification: Duplicate reservation/admission and real interrupted-subprocess probes; unknown remains stopped. No parallel-writer/tool-exclusion assurance is claimed.

invariants.statement: Checks, collection and acceptance bind to current task inputs and candidate.
invariants.verification: Edit relevant tracked/untracked/config/input bytes after evidence; gate rejects stale evidence.

invariants.statement: Collection is fresh and independent of implementation; acceptance is a separate fresh session from both.
invariants.verification: Reject wrong role, same session and invented provenance; admit three distinct valid observed role sessions.

invariants.statement: Initial implementation uses cycle zero; every authorized correction consumes exactly one of three persistent task cycles; no fourth correction.
invariants.verification: Cycle zero and three corrections across check/review routes; refuse fourth; replay/restart cannot reset or double-count; exhaustion preserves partial work and requests intervention.

invariants.statement: Current required evidence plus separate acceptance is the only single-task completion boundary.
invariants.verification: Missing/failed/stale/inconclusive evidence or failed approved-deferral recording blocks completion; replay completes once. Commit/dependency requirements from old scope are superseded.

invariants.statement: Interruption preserves work, history, correction count and a precise next action.
invariants.verification: Replacement coordinator reads status without chat reconstruction; live/unknown operation prevents retry; known terminal outcome may be collected idempotently.

invariants.statement: Omission, pass, failure, stale, blocked and not-run remain distinct.
invariants.verification: Required stages cannot be omitted; optional extra-stage omissions, missing evidence and product/infrastructure/blocker outcomes remain distinct in status/report.

flows.name: One prepared task through correction and acceptance
flows.trigger: Human-reviewed brief and verification document plus approved sbx execution policy
flows.terminal_outcome: Accepted current single-task work and recorded bounded deferrals, or preserved work/evidence with precise blocker; no automatic commit or next-task release

steps.actor: Preflight actor via adapter; controller admits readiness (T-003)
steps.action: Freeze approved inputs/policy; reserve through IF-001 and launch named preflight role through IF-002. Check actual sbx tools/dependencies/required installed skills; IF-003 admits terminal ART-004 and readiness into ART-002 bound to current ART-001. Missing prerequisites block implementation. Preflight/retry consumes no correction cycle and does not replace INV-004 roles.
Execute authorized implementation and collect observed terminal outcome
Inspect candidate/scope and execute real required checks; distinguish product from infrastructure failure
steps.state_transition: terminal -> checks -> collection-ready or correction/infrastructure recovery

steps.action: Rerun relevant checks through controller runner, inspect requirements/behavior/code and publish evidence/findings without acceptance

steps.actor: Separate fresh acceptance reviewer via adapter
steps.action: Judge current evidence and dispositions; accept, request correction/missing evidence or report blocker
On admitted correction request count launch once; change files, repeat checks, fresh collection and separate acceptance; unknown occupancy uses fresh session
Record approved bounded deferrals idempotently; recheck current evidence/scope/terminality and complete once
steps.state_transition: gate-eligible -> completed or evidence/blocker; no commit/dependency release

flows.name: Interruption and safe handoff
flows.terminal_outcome: Preserved work/evidence and known next action, or unknown ownership explicitly stopped

steps.action: Retain records/work; establish terminal/live/unknown using supported observations; absent receipt is not no-launch proof
Read durable status; collect known terminal result idempotently or stop before retry while liveness uncertain
steps.state_transition: known terminal -> permitted next stage; live/unknown -> stopped

flows.name: Refusal, missing evidence and intervention
flows.trigger: Invalid request, scope drift, stale evidence, inconclusive outcome or exhausted corrections
flows.terminal_outcome: Unchanged authority on invalid requests; authorized bounded recovery or precise persisted blocker relayed in active chat

steps.action: Refuse invalid/stale/unauthorized requests; separate diagnostics only

Admit operational outcomes; route product correction, missing evidence or infrastructure repair within authority; persist unresolved blocker and chat response history. Owner-authorized task/policy revisions go through T-002 IF-001 safe-boundary revision, state-version bump and readiness/affected-evidence invalidation; acknowledgement alone cannot change policy.
steps.state_transition: outcome -> authorized recovery or intervention; silence/acknowledgement is not recovery authority

tasks.title: Establish harness boundary
tasks.outcome: Historical transport selection and truthful capability limits retained
tasks.integration_boundary: Historical ART-008/follow-up/discovery/acceptance supply selected CLI bridge and known limits; preserve old INCONCLUSIVE readiness and unresolved F-01. Revised owner direction removes old isolation/commit gates for this delivery.
tasks.task_planner_context: Do not rerun old aggregate qualification or rewrite accepted reports. T-002 reconciles historical input with revised scope; T-003 owns actual sbx runtime supplement.

tasks.title: Expose guarded single-task operations
tasks.outcome: Status/reservations enforce required stages, authority, one active operation and persistent correction budget
tasks.integration_boundary: Locally prove state/version and reservation guards, required stage roles and three-correction accounting without model launches. Freeze approved model/context/sbx policy; invalid requests preserve authority/files. Own authorized ART-001 revision at a safe boundary: atomically increment state version/input identity, clear readiness and invalidate affected evidence; retain history/correction count and refuse unauthorized, stale-version or unsafe revisions unchanged.
tasks.task_planner_context: Historical T-001 dependency supplies evidence, not old isolation/commit qualification gates. Synchronize constants/schema/focused tests for gpt-6.1-sol low/medium/high, fresh correction on unknown occupancy and explicit sbx/YOLO authority. Preserve old frozen runs; no silent migration. Prepare bounded brief/verification/readiness before execution. Safe revision means no reserved/running/unknown operation and task not completed. Fresh preflight is required after revision; no silent policy update from chat acknowledgement.

tasks.title: Connect sbx actors and conservative interruption
tasks.outcome: Authorized sbx actors have observed provenance, retained output and precise terminality/stop behavior
tasks.integration_boundary: Selected CLI adapter applies approved policy, observes real operation/session identity and terminality; duplicate operation cannot relaunch and unknown liveness stops retry. Publish sbx runtime supplement and active-chat blocker routing. Own named adapter-launched preflight: reserve operation, record observed terminal ART-004, admit current-input readiness in ART-002 or precise prerequisite blocker, and prove no correction charge. IF-004 slice is stop/intervene/blocker persistence; ART-006/009 production is raw transport capture only.
tasks.task_planner_context: Adapt full-access refusal only for persisted authorized sbx/YOLO policy; apply T-002 approved model/context mapping. Distinct collection/acceptance transports are available for T-004/005. No tool-exclusion qualification, parallel scheduler or automatic recovery service. Actual runtime proof is distinct from fake tests. Preflight is required before implementation and again after authorized input/policy revision; it does not replace implementation/collection/acceptance independence. T-004 owns ART-006 semantics, T-005 owns ART-009 admission and IF-004 completion; extend one controller admission/persistence path, not competing paths.

tasks.title: Collect evidence and repeat bounded correction
tasks.outcome: Independent collection reruns checks and drives evidence-bound corrections
tasks.integration_boundary: Real corrected fixture changes a failing required check to passing; fresh collection reruns checks and retains stable findings. Reject stale candidate/input evidence and exhausted correction requests.
tasks.task_planner_context: Collection publishes evidence/findings without final acceptance; T-005 supplies separate decisions consumed for routing. Use admission fixtures until integrated; preserve applicable distinct workflow roles and prior dispositions. Cycle zero plus three shared corrections; unknown occupancy requires fresh correction session.

tasks.title: Admit separate acceptance and complete one task
tasks.outcome: Separate acceptance and current evidence gate single-task completion
tasks.integration_boundary: Reject same-session acceptance, missing/stale/inconclusive evidence and unrecorded approved deferrals. Route correction/missing evidence/blockers; valid current acceptance completes once without commit or dependent task. Own ART-009 semantic admission and IF-004 completion gate/publication; T-003 supplies only transport capture and stop/intervene/blocker persistence.
tasks.task_planner_context: Keep collector and acceptance sessions separate. Coordinator records approved bounded issues in declared/default tracker with stable provenance/history; failed recording blocks completion and task drift invalidates evidence. JSON migration/classifier/new stop rule deferred. Integrated T-004/005 loop closes both routing contracts. Reuse T-003 transport and the shared controller persistence/admission path; do not duplicate record validators or persistence.

tasks.title: Deliver coordinator instructions and sbx proof
tasks.outcome: Owner can run the documented single-task loop with truthful evidence and limitations
tasks.integration_boundary: One separately authorized actual sbx pilot includes preflight, real correction/checks, independent collection and separate acceptance. Show conservative interruption status and active-chat intervention; report any unrun live proof explicitly.
tasks.task_planner_context: Update current instructions/references/examples with implemented commands and required roles. Inspect installer on profile/dependency changes without auto-adding orchestrator or refreshing active installations. Commit/dependency/containment/parallel work deferred; historical T-001 host evidence is not sbx qualification.
